notes.title: GDoC Expo 2025 | UPDATE Ver. 0.6.0
notes.notes:
A year ago, during GDoC Expo 2024, Shinehill was released in early access! 
And today, at the wonderful Game Devs of Color Expo 2025, we are releasing an update!

What's in this update? 

Key features:

 Endgame content
 2 new quests with Stacy
 2 new quests with Brian
 The recipe book now displays description and price of items
 Side quests are tracked automatically 


Other improvements:

 Added full inventory notification 
 Turned off ticking of the clock during cutscenes
 Player running is enabled by default
 Changed displayed button for harvesting
 Friendship points added when kissing NPC
 Fixed music during fishing festival
 Berserk drink can be sold
 Extended wine effect
 Fruit cocktail is sold by the snail vendor
 Updated Helpinator 3000 design
 Updated teleport design
 Updated books design
 Fixed the main menu
 Fixed a bug with the achievement for the golden house
 Added a hint to Ben's quest
 Shortened fishing at the fishing festival
 Bug fixed during Pinky's date quest
 Polish language fix
 Typo correction


Thank you for supporting Shinehill! We are working on new updates, stay tuned! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/e39b3c706158b318fcfdd6b720b3fea7bdecfe78.png

notes.title: UPDATE Ver. 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
The second major update was released today! Very excited to tell you more about it:
New system of interacting with NPCs:

 Ability to hug/kiss NPCs
 You can gift NPCs any items
 You can acces the store through NPCs
 Friendship log
 Tracking of side quests
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/2d0e14d974cccae4119cae463667b24a8e9ecff3.png

Obstacle avoidance system for the player:
We've been wanting to add this for a long time and we finally made it! The new collision detection and avoidance system will help you not to get stuck in objects. Your character will automatically walk around the obstacle from the nearest possible angle.
It will be much more comfortable to play this way!

New decoration system (just talk to the mayor):

 You can choose the color of the roof
 You can choose the color of the walls inside the house
 You can upgrade the furniture inside the house
 New items for decorating the farm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/15adb4d9d0fa8334e2093dd6361b53a04f64cded.png

Other updates:

 The first festival in Shinehill
 Added swordfish
 Added penguin (pet)
 Added eggplant
Bugfixes, etc:

 Added X button to exit menus everywhere
 Inventory acces by Esc button
 Removed the invisible wall at the daily quest board
 Every morning quest pop up appears
 Number of items is now displayed when confirming actions with said item
 Huge pumpkin drops 7 to 10 seeds
 Simplified sand swimmer
 Simplified starfish
 Boris sells ruff that's needed for the main storyline
 Fixed a bug that allowed to create a seedbed with open inventory

We really hope you enjoy these updates!
If you have any questions or encounter any difficulties, please post them on Steam discussions or on our Discord!

We've also started preparations for a small change in the game interfaces so that players on SteamDeck can see everything clearly. We hope that we will be able to release this update soon!

Thank you for being with us and have a nice day!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #1 Ver. 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The first major update is coming out today. Ver. 0.2.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/adc33dd7b041259c9a739367d764a49ef8479fe1.png
What's new:

 The finale of the main storyline of Shinehill Island
 2 quests at Lucy's (Side quest + Date quest)
 Date quest with Pinky
 Date quest with Rudy
 Date quest with Crystal
 Teleports
 New enemies: boars, moles, fire bats, oil burdock, cloud, 2 kinds of bugs
 2 new story bosses. Each of them has their own unique mechanics. We hope you will find them interesting!
 2 new dungeons
 Mini puzzles in the dungeons
 New drop from enemies, fishes, and materials. All of these have been added to the collection
 New achievements

Fixed/finished:

 Fixed the clipping in the snail
 Fixed typos
 Reduced the amount of coffee in the bunker
 Changed the stamina formula
 Changed the price of jam
 The price of selling and buying garden tools is equal (if you accidentally sold a pickaxe/axe, you can buy it right away)
 Changed the color of the description in the inventory to black
 Benches and sofa restore more stamina
 Face emotes in all quests
 Evil plants attack less often
 Reduced golem attack power
 Mountain and winter location improved + new music
 Started working on localization, thanks to volunteers. Turkish language has already been updated in this update! Thanks again to the volunteers! We will continue to work and gradually improve localization, as well as add more languages.

We will be very grateful if you share your opinion about the new content and the game in general! Write to us in Steam discussions, on peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com or join the Discord server!
Thanks to you we can balance the game and make adjustments to make it better.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/e39b3c706158b318fcfdd6b720b3fea7bdecfe78.png

There are so many plans for future updates. We will try to implement them all as soon as possible!
Perhaps now we will release smaller updates, gradually adding new content in smaller amounts, but more often. This seems more convenient (but we'll think about it some more)
We'll be sure to share information about what we're working on and what's coming in upcoming updates! ❤️

Thank you so much for being with us!
We are very happy that Shinehill has such a wonderful community!
We wish you all the best and have a great day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889890/Shinehill/

notes.title: About the major update #1 | DEVLOG
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I'd like to talk more about the upcoming Shinehill update!
The first major update is scheduled for November 27th.
What are we working on now? What will be in the update?

The finale of the main story:
You will learn the whole truth! 
The main story will increase by about 30%. It will include 2 new boss battles and an interesting narrative!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/659ec9b84db51d6c41f0b80af7559b19ac08d8fc.png

New quests with the villagers!  
In this update, we're adding romantic date quests with Rudy, Crystal, Lucy and Pinky.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/892d0e8090f9504654a3711e566f0c65d43be40d.png

Teleports!!!
You asked for them - we made them!
Teleporting will cost you disguise points, so be careful.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/8a47d65f71a59e30ddd6c087ec97feeb970dd504.png

New mobs in the locations:
The mountain and winter coast will now be filled with mobs!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/b9040bb8b06970ef991f4e0a9a2cf6590554324c.png


What will be added later (this list may grow based on your suggestions): 

 New side quests (each NPC has 4-5 quests planned) 
 Character customization - There will be more “human costumes” to choose from 
 Full mouse support 
 Festivals 
 New pets 
 More crops to grow 
 Ask NPCs out for a date (in the future, possibly marriage as well) 
 Events after the final main quest 
 And more things that we will decide on with the community!

 Improved localization! 
The translation process has already started, we will post more details about recruiting volunteers a little later. But if you want to start now - please write us an email! 
peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com


We would also like to say a huge thank you to everyone! 
Thank you for playing Shinehill and supporting us! We are very happy!
We wish you all the best and see you soon! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/e39b3c706158b318fcfdd6b720b3fea7bdecfe78.png

notes.title: Wholesome Games Steam Celebration | Demo update
notes.notes:
We are very excited that Shinehill will be participating in the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration! 
On August 15-21! 
In honor of this, we've updated the demo so you can appreciate how the game has changed in the meantime!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/4dad857413119596ffc28fc59fef396abfbc2d61.png

The main changes in the demo are:

 Character progression system
 Added map
 The main quest is always displayed on the screen
 New menu
 New settings
 and many other less noticeable improvements.


We'll also be making a big announcement during the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, stay tuned!

Thank you for your support, it is very important for us!
